status_note: The five targeted insertion projections are byte-identical MATCH, but six distinct branches remain UNTESTED under TRANSFORM-MULTIEQUAL-INSERT-RESIDUAL-0001, so the fixture-level B2 status is UNTESTED.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: TransformOp.follow refers to the exact placeholder whose replacement supplies the parent block; replacement/output/input identities are preserved and compared through stable encounter labels. createReplacement mutates each TransformOp.replacement and, when output is non-null, the paired TransformVar.replacement/def relationship.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: TransformManager::createOps visits newOps once in list/arena creation order, then repeatedly visits the same order until no follow remains. Two MULTIEQUALs are each inserted at block begin, so the later-created op precedes the earlier one; non-PHI ops insert immediately before the same target and retain creation order.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: The target functions have no explicit local accumulator. PcodeOpBank uniqid advances exactly once per created replacement and SeqNum time is observed; createOps followCount is reset to zero each retry, incremented only for still-pending insertions, and terminates at zero.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: The decisive branch key is exact opcode equality with CPUI_MULTIEQUAL plus follow->follow completion state. No container sort is performed; final order is determined by BlockBasic insertion position, while the fixture compares opcode, SeqNum time/order, identity, def-use and counts without re-sorting.

overlay.policy: The only live library-source input; hash-verify before replacing the pinned base transform.rs

rugra_source.archive_policy: Immutable explicit dependency closure plus one verified transform.rs overlay; unrelated worktree files are excluded

analysis_options.funcdata: Four BfdArchitecture function shells over immutable 34a3febf:examples/curl; no followFlow and no Action pass; one synthetic BlockBasic and one integrated outputless COPY anchor per case
analysis_options.placeholder_construction: Each immediate case creates two newOpReplace placeholders against the same anchor. Each follow case creates one immediate COPY replacement followed by two newOp placeholders sharing it. Every generated op has a unique output and fixed constant inputs
analysis_options.case_matrix: createReplacement immediate and attemptInsertion follow branches crossed with CPUI_MULTIEQUAL and CPUI_COPY
analysis_options.debug_macros: __TERMINAL__ only; OPACTION_DEBUG, CPUI_DEBUG and TYPEPROP_DEBUG absent
analysis_options.diagnostics: BfdArchitecture initialization diagnostics captured privately and excluded from the target API observation
analysis_options.normalization: Only raw unique-space offsets and process pointer values are omitted. Stable vN/oN encounter labels preserve all aliasing; opcode, SeqNum time/order, parent, create index, size, space index, constant value, def-use and counts are byte-compared

observation_schema.format: Four fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.op_projection: Exact block order, opcode, SeqNum time/order, parent index, output identity and ordered input identities
observation_schema.varnode_projection: First-encounter identity, create index, size, address-space index, constant value, defining op and ordered descendant ops
observation_schema.count_projection: block ops, projected varnodes, alive/dead/all bank ops and total Funcdata varnodes
observation_schema.anchor_projection: Original anchor dead state and parent detachment
observation_schema.preserved: No order, alias, control-flow, identity or count field is normalized; only unique offsets and raw pointers are intentionally absent

build.oracle_archive: Exact locked Ghidra commit archive and locked Makefile libdecomp.a
build.rugra_archive: Immutable 5dc86bac dependency closure plus hash-pinned src/transform.rs overlay
build.rust_build: Cargo --locked --offline in isolated target, then rustc for separately hashed fixture

replacement_multiequal_begin_order.covers: createReplacement immediate path with two CPUI_MULTIEQUAL replacements, including reversed block-begin order

follow_multiequal_begin_order.covers: attemptInsertion follow path with two CPUI_MULTIEQUAL ops sharing one completed follow

replacement_nonphi_order.covers: createReplacement immediate non-PHI control with two CPUI_COPY replacements retaining creation order

follow_nonphi_order.covers: attemptInsertion follow non-PHI control with two CPUI_COPY ops retaining before-follow creation order

identity_and_counts.covers: all four cases compare op/varnode identity, aliases, SeqNum time/order, parent, def-use and block/bank counts

op_preexisting_resize_path.covers: op_preexisting opcode mutation and input shrink/grow/null-slot handling are not exercised

nested_follow_chain.covers: attemptInsertion while follow->follow is still non-null and requires another retry is not exercised

indirect_special_handling.covers: INDIRECT creation flags, inheritIndirect and specialHandling are not exercised

insertion_error_paths.covers: missing-parent, malformed-placeholder and injected failure behavior are not exercised

create_replacement_output_null.covers: createReplacement with output == nullptr, where no output TransformVar is materialized, is not exercised

blockbasic_setorder_renumber_boundary.covers: an exhausted SeqNum order midpoint that forces BlockBasic::setOrder renumbering during insertion is not exercised

branches.detail: TransformOp::createReplacement's op_preexisting opcode/input resize path is outside this insertion fixture
attemptInsertion with a follow whose own follow remains pending is not covered
INDIRECT creation flags and specialHandling are not exercised
missing-parent, malformed-placeholder and failure injection paths are not exercised
createReplacement with output == nullptr is not exercised
BlockBasic insertion with no midpoint order available, forcing setOrder renumbering, is not exercised
